name: Pepperoncini
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated due to low FODMAP content. The vinegar brine may provide digestive benefits for some individuals.
preparationTips: Rinse briefly if sodium content is a concern
Use whole peppers as a garnish or slice for salads
Add to dishes at the end of cooking to preserve texture
Store opened jars in refrigerator and use within 2-3 months
nutritionalHighlights: Provides small amounts of vitamin A
